title: ADAPT: Audio-Depth Action Planning with Transition-Aware Rewards for Lights-Out Industrial Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language-action models for embodied navigation typically rely on RGB observations, limiting their applicability in lights-out industrial environments where visible illumination may be unavailable. We study illumination-independent navigation using spatial audio for target localization and depth for obstacle-aware geometry. To support this setting, we introduce DarkNav-Bench, a benchmark with 24 industrial scenes and four progressively challenging acoustic conditions. We further propose ADAPT, an audio-depth action-planning framework equipped with spatial-audio perception and optimized for closed-loop navigation through reinforcement learning (RL). Our key RL contribution, transition-aware reward shaping (TARS), defines a pose-aware shortest-action potential over a position-heading graph. translated_title: ADAPT：基于转换感知奖励的音频-深度动作规划方法，用于无灯工业环境导航
translated_abstract: 面向具身导航的视觉-语言-动作模型通常依赖RGB观测，这限制了它们在可能缺乏可见光照的无灯工业环境中的适用性。我们研究一种与光照无关的导航方式，利用空间音频进行目标定位，并利用深度信息进行避障感知的几何理解。为支持这一设定，我们提出了DarkNav-Bench，一个包含24个工业场景和四种渐进难度声学条件的基准测试。我们进一步提出ADAPT，一个配备空间音频感知能力的音频-深度动作规划框架，并通过强化学习（RL）针对闭环导航进行优化。我们关键的强化学习贡献是转换感知奖励塑造（TARS），它在位置-朝向图上定义了一个姿态感知的最短动作势函数。与传统的测地线进度奖励不同，TARS同时考虑了可行移动和原地旋转，从而提供动作一致的反馈（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出ADAPT框架，利用空间音频与深度信息替代RGB观测，并通过转换感知奖励塑造（TARS）的强化学习优化，实现无灯工业环境中与光照无关的自主导航，同时发布了包含24个工业场景的DarkNav-Bench基准。
en_tdlr: ADAPT is an audio-depth action-planning framework optimized with transition-aware reward shaping (TARS) via reinforcement learning, enabling illumination-independent navigation in lights-out industrial environments, evaluated on the new DarkNav-Bench benchmark.
